title: Sakkarbaug Zoological Park, Junagadh - A Legacy of Wildlife Conservation
content:
Sakkarbaug Zoological Park, Junagadh

Located in the heart of Junagadh, Gujarat, Sakkarbaug Zoological Park (also known as Sakkarbaug Zoo) is one of India’s oldest and most renowned zoos, established in 1863 by the Nawab of Junagadh. Spread across 200 hectares, this zoo is not just a tourist attraction but also a significant center for wildlife conservation and breeding, particularly for Asiatic lions, which are native to the nearby Gir Forest.

The zoo is home to a diverse collection of animals, birds, and reptiles, including tigers, leopards, lions, cheetahs, elephants, deer, peacocks, and exotic bird species. It also houses rare and endangered animals from India and other parts of the world. The Asiatic Lion Breeding Centre, located within the zoo, is internationally recognized for its success in conservation and repopulation efforts.

Apart from animal exhibits, Sakkarbaug Zoo also features a Natural History Museum, botanical gardens, and education centers that promote awareness about wildlife protection. The clean, well-maintained surroundings and shaded walkways make it a pleasant spot for families, nature lovers, and school groups.

Visitors can enjoy observing animals in semi-natural enclosures that provide both comfort to the animals and safety for visitors. With its blend of education, conservation, and recreation, Sakkarbaug Zoological Park stands as a proud symbol of Gujarat’s commitment to wildlife preservation.

History and Significance

Founded during the princely state of Junagadh, Sakkarbaug Zoo was created as a royal menagerie and later developed into a modern zoological park. It became the breeding ground for the endangered Asiatic lions, helping increase their population and reintroduce them to protected areas like the Gir National Park.

Entry Fee and Timings

Entry Fee:

  • Adults: ₹30
  • Children: ₹10
  • Foreigners: ₹50

Timings: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (Closed on Wednesdays)

Best Time to Visit

The best time to visit Sakkarbaug Zoo is from October to February, when the weather is pleasant for walking and exploring the outdoor exhibits. Early mornings or late afternoons are ideal for spotting animals when they are most active.

How to Reach

  • By Road: The zoo is easily accessible from Junagadh city center, just 2 km away. Buses and auto-rickshaws are available.
  • By Train: Junagadh Junction is the nearest railway station (3 km from the zoo).
  • By Air: The nearest airport is Rajkot Airport (105 km), well-connected to major Indian cities.
